svg.title: An assertion whose two sides are the same variable cannot fail
svg.desc: Left: the assertion as written compares the recorded pid against the very variable the test passed in, so it passes. Middle: the regression reinstated supplies a literal the host decides, and the same assertion still passes because both sides moved together. Right: an assertion against a source the test did not supply fails on the reinstated literal. The prompt asks the reviewer to state, per added assertion, what would have to be true of the code for it to fail, and to name one comparing a value against the variable the test itself passed in rather than against an independent source.
